title: Getting Started: Your First Catch
description: You looking to start fishing, matey? Bring me three worm bait and I'll help you get started.

objectives.description: Gather 3 worms by digging in dirt blocks around the dock.
Catch 1 Mackerel. Tip: Use bait! Try digging in the dirt around the dock for worms.
Sell 1 Mackerel at the Fishmonger in town.
